conventions: One entry per code and side. Side A is the front, side B the back of a double-sided card; a shadow effect is a line of side A.
lines are the ability text of the text box in print order, one ability per line: no title, traits, stats, flavor text, or Victory line. Keyword lines (Surge., Hide 2.) stay.
Icons are written as the words Hall of Beorn uses (Willpower, Attack, Defense, Threat, Lore, Fellowship). Apostrophes are straight.
A printed typo is written corrected in lines, and the printed wording is kept under misprints.
inert lists line numbers that need no effect record, with the reason. A line that is only keywords the engine reads is owned by the keyword.

A Nightmare card is read from the Nightmare proxies' picture (the `nightmare` source), pinned again as its scan. Side B of a setup card is its recipe, which the build applies (scripts/data/normalize/nightmare.ts): each of its lines is inert.

lines: Begin with the standard quest deck and encounter deck for the Flight to the Ford scenario.
Remove the following cards, in the specified quantities, from the standard encounter deck:
4x Fell Rider
1x Ford of Bruinen
1x The Troll's Camp
3x Ettenmoors
3x Pain Assailed Him
3x The Old Road
3x Pathless Country
3x Stricken Dumb
2x Rode Like a Gale
Then, shuffle the encounter cards in this Nightmare Deck into the remainder of the standard Flight to the Ford encounter deck.
Finally, flip this setup card over and place it next to the quest deck. Its effect remains active throughout the game, which is now ready to begin.
